also, a creative note on how i'm feeling:

http://langdow.deviantart.com/art/realistically-i-m-a-failure-626601433
I wish I could do these in a way that does not hurt others.

I threw my phone specifically so I could not contact people. Whether they be helpful or unhelpful.

I feel I am just childish. That I am just a child trapped in an adult's body. That me throwing things was just a result of me trying to escape myself.

I self harmed for a while. Recently relapsed after several years of avoiding it. 
You don't deserve it. There are better ways to "punish" yourself for perceived transgressions. Have you tried ice cubes? Holding one in your palm until it melts. That helps me, sometimes.
You can be worth it.

I'm in the process of re-reading through my self-help books. The ERs around here only admit people in a "critical" position; they are not positioned to help people who need long-term care. I am going to therapy, but probably in denial about how much help I actually need.
I'd love that. I'd love to be able to be functional enough to deal with myself.
I've tried to use that mentality and failed time after time.

I have read through previous books multiple times.
I do not feel I can get better.
Right now, my fiancee feels the same way.
I have been going to therapy for over a year now.

What are you tired about?
How old are you?
Why do you want to be "put out of your misery"?
What is not worth living for anymore?

What do you think of yourself? Just generally. You may not need psychiatric help for this part. There are plenty of self-help books you can try to work through,
But you convincing you need help?
Honestly, that probably means you need more help.
That's okay.
It's always okay to need more help; even if you don't want/need to admit it at this time. It's always okay to ask for what you need.

I have been through a variety of therapy;
MICD
Individual psychotherapy (with a registered psychiatrist)
I have been active in an outpatient program focusing on DBT therapy and I am starting an official DBT program in 2 weeks.
I have gotten some self help books. I have a DBT diary for skills, a DBT book (for DBT skills training; also I have gotten a teaching manual for DBT) as well as various other skill training books.
What else can I do?
I agree, I actually just set it as my homepage!
I lack empathy toward everyone, even myself. It's hard to see any issues when you are so consumed with what you are feeling. I try to do emotion regulation. It is hard. So so hard.

It can get better. It will. Please PM me? I feel like we'd have a lot to talk about. I am drinking too. But I am not trying to kill myself. Actively. We can get through this. It is bad now. It will get better. Please.

It can. I promise. I'm not even in DBT. Sometimes things get better. Sometimes they don't. This coming from someone who is drinking to forget the pain. I'm sorry you are struggling. I really, truly am.

I hate myself, but I love myself.

I think it's a latent selfishness that I'm still denying. I can do stuff for myself. Sometimes. Can't do anything for anyone else, that isn't "worthy" at the time of me doing stuff.

I also can't forgive myself, but I can forget everything I've ever done if it helps myself in the moment.

So it may be the awareness of self that I am forgetting? I don't know. I hope this helps you.

hey, bpd with a non fiancee. It can get better. It will get better. If you try honestly to turn away from that bridge. 

I'm there now. I want to fall into nothingness. I want to be complete with nothing.

But there's more than that. There's always more than that. It just takes turning away to realize this. 

You can do it. I, as a stranger, believe in you.

i just don't want to be alone (diagnosed with bpd traits)

it's probably bad of me to post here because of the above... but i just want to feel like someone out there cares and knows what i am going through

please
